units.source_text: 女人说着，抬头望望坝上。

en.t: As the woman spoke, she raised her head and looked up toward the top of the embankment.

units.source_text: 她的脸也变得干巴巴的，透过贴着的沙层，看得清她的脸上血色全无。

en.t: Her face too had become dry and parched; through the layer of sand clinging to it, he could clearly see that there was no color in her face at all.

units.source_text: 蓦地，周围暗了下来，被涂抹上清一色的铁锈色。

en.t: Suddenly, the surroundings grew dark, as if everything had been smeared with a uniform rust color.

units.source_text: 他在朦胧的意识隧道里摸索着前进，好容易摸到了鱼肠似的渗满油脂的床铺。

en.t: He groped his way forward through the tunnel of his dim consciousness, and at last managed to feel his way to the bed, greasy and slick like fish entrails.

units.source_text: 女人到底什么时候回来的，他连一点记忆也没有。

en.t: He had no memory at all of exactly when the woman had come back.
